location: _git() (git command line); verify() parent and ancestry checks
title: Forged commit-graph makes a direct push verify as a two-parent merge (F-01 partly closed)
evidence: Version added by direct commit c1; empty commit c2; BIND names reviewed_head=c1, merge_commit=c2. After `git commit-graph write --reachable` the two parent slots of c2 in the CDAT chunk were set to (base, c1) and the trailer re-hashed. Result: transitions APPLIED, bound_by 2. Same with a split chain (objects/info/commit-graphs). git status clean; HEAD unchanged; no refs/replace; no info/grafts. With `-c core.commitGraph=false` plain git reports 1 parent. The previous review listed `-c core.commitGraph=false` in the required correction; it was not added.
consequence: An offline verifier given a copied or archived repository accepts a version that never went through a merge, while HEAD equals the published commit and the worktree is clean. BIND topology is the only offline activation control.
reproduction: python scratchpad/rr3/scripts/bind4.py <copy of worktree>  (cases N2, N2c). Fix confirmed in a scratch copy: with the option added both cases are rejected and 153 tests pass.
required_correction: Add `-c core.commitGraph=false` to every git call in _git(); add one test per form (single file, split chain); state in APPROVAL_CONTROLS.md that verification assumes an object store not tampered with, and recommend `git fsck` on a received copy.

title: Nested .git directory or .git file in the ledger root diverts verification to another history (F-01 partly closed)
evidence: Outer repository: ledger under pkg/, version and BIND line added by one direct commit: rejected ('commit ... is not in the local history'). After copying an attacker repository's .git into the ledger root: APPLIED, bound_by 2; outer `git status --short` empty; outer HEAD unchanged. Same with a one-line .git file `gitdir: <attacker .git>`. This is the on-disk equivalent of the GIT_DIR case A8.
consequence: As R-01: a tampered copy verifies although the real history has no merge; `git status` in the real repository does not show the nested .git.
required_correction: For the committed ledger require the repository top to be the expected ancestor (prefix exactly legal_knowledge/audit_work/AUTH-LEDGER), or fail closed when a .git entry exists at the ledger root or in any directory between it and the expected top; add a test for the directory form and the gitdir-file form; document the residual.

title: F-07 partly closed: '...' segments and a few decoded forms still accepted
evidence: Accepted: https://x.gov.in/.../a ; https://x.gov.in/..../a (named in F-07) ; https://x.gov.in/%20/a ; %E2%88%95 (U+2215), %E2%81%84 (U+2044), %E2%A7%B8 (U+29F8) ; %EF%BF%BD (U+FFFD) ; a leading combining mark %CC%B8. Rejected as intended: fullwidth dot and solidus, bidi and zero-width characters, C1 controls, NBSP, line separator, surrogates, overlong and invalid UTF-8 in path and query, '..%20', '.%20', '%20..'.
